difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: in the situation of the preceding construction the category C_{X/Lambda} is fibred over the etale site of X (source lines 4614-4618). The proof is the etale-site analogue of the Zariski statement: for an object U -> A and a morphism U' -> U of the etale site one takes the composite U' -> U -> A as the new object and verifies directly that the induced morphism is strongly cartesian over the etale site.
